title: Implement durable infrastructure health telemetry and incident recovery
summary_zh: 建立非交易 infrastructure telemetry authority，補 error-rate spike、完整 downstream registry、durable probe state、delivery retry/DLQ及 incident resolve，移除會被 binding validation 拒絕的 sentinel。
